description: Free. Returns every agentdatafeed dataset with record count, last update, price per query, filters and links. Call it first to choose a dataset, then use get_sample to inspect records or query_dataset for filtered data. When to use each dataset: amsterdam-events: Use when a user asks what is on in Amsterdam on a date or in a district, plans travel, venues, staffing, security or deliveries around large events, or needs crowd sizes, road closures context or permit status before the event appears on ticket sites. security-advisories: Use when a user asks whether a CVE is actively exploited, which vulnerabilities in a vendor or product to patch first, whether it is used in ransomware campaigns, or needs CISA KEV due dates, required actions and FIRST EPSS exploit probability in one call. vulnerability-watch: Use when a user asks which recent vulnerabilities affect a server product or version, wants new critical CVEs (for example CVSS 9 or higher) for a vendor this week, or needs CVSS, affected version ranges and exploit signals (KEV, EPSS) for a CVE in the news. eu-tenders: Use when a user asks which public tenders or government contracts are open in an EU country or sector, wants bid opportunities by CPV code or keyword with a deadline, or needs to monitor what public buyers are procuring before the deadline passes. uk-tenders: Use when a user asks which UK government or public sector contracts are open to bid, wants UK tender opportunities by sector, CPV code, keyword, region or buyer with the deadline and value, or needs Find a Tender and Contracts Finder notices in one search, for example SME-friendly IT tenders in Scotland closing this month. au-contracts: Use when a user asks which Australian Government agencies buy a product or service, who won federal contracts in a UNSPSC category, what a supplier or competitor (by name or ABN) has been awarded and for how much, or needs AusTender contract values for market sizing, for example IT consulting contracts above AUD 1 million awarded by Defence this year. eu-funding: Use when a user asks which EU grants, subsidies or Horizon Europe calls are open or coming up for a topic, sector or organisation type, needs the deadline, budget and call link for an EU funding opportunity, or looks for small cascade funding calls for SMEs and start-ups. us-grants: Use when a user asks which US federal grants or cooperative agreements are open or coming up for a topic, agency or applicant type (for example small businesses, nonprofits, tribal governments or universities), needs the close date, award ceiling, Assistance Listing number and Grants.gov link for a funding opportunity, or wants US federal funding next to EU calls from eu-funding. cert-advisories: Use when a user asks whether the Dutch, German or French national CERT or CERT-EU has warned about a CVE, vendor or product, needs the official European advisory ID and link for a patch or NIS2 report, or wants recent government advisories that cover known exploited (CISA KEV) vulnerabilities. eu-medicines: Use when a user asks whether a medicine or active substance is authorised in the EU, who holds the marketing authorisation, what it is indicated for, whether there is a current EMA-monitored shortage, or which safety communications and referral procedures concern it. sanctions-entities: Use when a user or a KYC, AML, procurement or shipping workflow needs to check whether a company, organisation, vessel or aircraft is on the EU, US OFAC, UK or Canadian sanctions list, see on which of these lists it appears with each programme and listing date, find the legal basis of a listing, or look up a sanctioned vessel by IMO number, for example "is this supplier, ship owner or counterparty sanctioned?" before onboarding or payment; not for screening individual people. product-recalls: Use when a user, shop, marketplace, procurement or compliance workflow asks whether a product, food, medicine, medical device, vehicle, tyre or child car seat has been recalled or flagged as unsafe in the US (FDA, CPSC, NHTSA), Canada, the UK or the EU (Safety Gate for non-food products, RASFF for food and feed), which allergen, contaminant or hazard caused it, how serious the recall class or risk is, whether a recalled car should not be driven, which recalls concern a given brand, barcode, firm or vehicle make, which FDA medical device recalls concern a device type, product code or 510(k) or PMA number and why (root cause), or which EU alerts concern products from a given country of origin, for example "is this product recalled?" before it is sold, bought or shipped. eu-legislation: Use when a user, compliance, legal or policy workflow asks which EU regulations, directives or decisions were recently published or amended on a topic, whether an act is in force and from when, which acts amend or repeal a given CELEX number, or needs the CELEX, ELI or OJ reference and the official EUR-Lex link of an EU act. us-federal-register: Use when a user, compliance, legal or policy workflow asks which US federal rules, proposed rules, notices or executive orders were recently published by an agency or on a topic, when a rule takes effect, which comment periods are still open and until when, which documents affect a given CFR title or part, or needs the FR citation, docket ID, RIN and official link of a Federal Register document. drug-shortages: Use when a user, pharmacist, hospital, wholesaler or procurement workflow asks whether a medicine or active substance is currently in short supply in the US, the EU, Spain or France, why, since when, when supply is expected back, which manufacturers, strengths or packs are affected, or whether alternatives are available, for example "is amoxicillin in shortage in Spain or France?" public-holidays: Use when a user, scheduler, payroll, logistics or booking workflow needs to know whether a date is an official public or bank holiday in one of the covered countries or regions, which holidays fall in a date range, or how to count business days around holidays this year or next year, for example "is 26 December a bank holiday in Scotland?" travel-advisories: Use when a user, travel booking, duty-of-care or travel-risk workflow needs to know what the US, UK, Canadian or Dutch government currently advises about travelling to a country, wants to compare those governments' levels for one destination, list destinations at or above a level, or find advice levels that changed since a date. vat-rates: Use when an invoicing, checkout, accounting or e-commerce workflow needs the official VAT or GST rate of a country (or Canadian province) on a given date, the reduced or zero rate for a category of goods or services such as food, books or accommodation, or the history of rate changes. company-identifiers: Use when a know-your-customer, onboarding, invoice or supplier validation, or due diligence workflow needs the official LEI, registered name, legal form, business register number, country and parent of a legal entity that recently obtained an LEI, or needs to know whether a counterparty's LEI was recently retired, annulled, merged or its entity closed; for an older LEI with no recent change, check the record at the GLEIF link. hazard-alerts: Use when a logistics, travel, insurance or supply-chain workflow asks which earthquakes, wildfires, tropical cyclones, floods or other natural hazards hit or threaten a country, route or site in the last 30 days, how strong they were, and where to read the official report; the data is refreshed once a day, so do not use it for real-time or life-safety alerts. sec-filings: Use when a due diligence, investment research, compliance or monitoring workflow asks which filings a US-listed or SEC-registered company made recently, whether a company filed a new 8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, registration statement, late filing notice, delisting or Form D, which listed companies are the subject of a new 13D or 13G stake disclosure, or needs the accession number, CIK and sec.gov link of a recent filing.
